overview: A full-featured marketplace platform inspired by Jumia. Buyers browse a product catalog with categories, search, and detailed product pages. A persistent shopping cart leads to a checkout flow that creates real orders in the backend. Sellers manage their storefronts — listing products, tracking inventory, and fulfilling orders. An admin panel moderates the platform by approving sellers and products before they go live.
features: Product catalog with category browsing, search, and product detail pages with images
Persistent shopping cart with checkout flow and order confirmation
Seller dashboard to list products, manage inventory, and track orders
Buyer account with order history and real-time status updates
Admin panel to approve sellers and products before they go live
Role-based access control via Internet Identity (buyer, seller, admin)
Product image uploads via object storage
